\noindent Generated caption: RQ3 calibration. Held-out folds only (04 \S{}5.4); alpha 0.1 (each experiment's calibration.alpha, Alpha column). Coverage, set size, risk-coverage AURC (verified score V vs fused score F; H3c: AURC V $-$ F below 0 favours V) and NO\_FAULT rates are bench\_summary 1.2 entries (03 \S{}13.3), pooled over seeds; lower AURC is better. AC@1 and Retrieval@K carry summary.json's 95\% cluster-bootstrap interval; coverage, the AURCs, AURC V $-$ F and the false-alarm and wrong NO\_FAULT rates carry the 95\% cluster-bootstrap interval of rq3-intervals/\allowbreak{}\textless{}id\textgreater{}/\allowbreak{}summary.json where one is committed (scripts/\allowbreak{}rq3\_intervals.py, \#555; 04 \S{}8). Set-size columns are over the runs with a set; Runs not ok counts all the group's rows (fault cases and normal windows). $\tau$\_nf follows the 04 \S{}12 row of 2026-11-21 (logged 26 Nov; ADR 20261121-ak-calibration-fit-conventions): when its rank index lands on +$\infty$, $\tau$\_nf = default\_tau with calibrated = false, which gives a held-out false-alarm rate of 1; \vtref{t07c-rq3-tau-sensitivity} is the literal 04 \S{}5.4 reading that row reports as a sensitivity analysis. Pooled rows (system as stratum) are secondary (04 \S{}10 rule 3). Protocol: see Sources.\par
